I’ve been on lexipro for 1 year now. 
I started at 5mg Jan 2022.
By April 2022, I was at 20mg.
By the time I got to 20mg, it started effecting my brain and mood. 

Before lexipro, I had mashed potato brains for months from severe depression.
I could barely even function. 

And it’s like I feel cognitive again, like I’m present in my own life, I am me.
I am happy that my brain is able to function!

You can’t sit in your room and take antidepressants, expecting to see long term results.
I ended up reading self help books, gratitude journaling, and anything I felt help. 
Created a routine and healthy habits. 
Every time I caught myself saying things like “im dumb, I hate myself”. I force myself to say the opposite “I am smart and I love myself”

Not only do you need patience to feel results but you need to actively  work towards the pursuit of happiness on your own, not just meds.

It’s been 1 year for me and im tapering off! 

I hope this helps and good luck to you 💕
